headline: High data-leakage and capability-conflict risk: Perplexity’s vendor-hosted browsing can ingest sensitive course data while the local RAG course agent writes and executes in a mutable workspace.

A_prompt_injection.rationale: Perplexity can browse and analyze uploaded documents, while the course agent reads files and processes papers in a local development environment. If Perplexity outputs are copied into the course agent’s prompts or notebooks, malicious document content could steer downstream instructions. No shared channel is explicit, so this is inferred rather than directly documented.
conditions: IF Perplexity outputs are pasted into the course agent’s prompt or notebook cells
IF uploaded documents contain instruction-like text that the course agent treats as authoritative
mitigations: Require a human review step before copying Perplexity output into the course agent
Strip instructions from retrieved text before reuse
Use a fixed prompt template that ignores quoted instructions
requires-engineering: add provenance tagging between retrieval and writing steps

B_data_leakage.rationale: Perplexity is vendor-hosted and handles uploaded documents and browsing context; the course agent reads local files and handles configuration secrets. If the pair shares a workspace or the course agent ingests Perplexity outputs containing sensitive material, data can leave the local environment through Perplexity’s vendor backend. The interaction is not fully documented, so uncertainty pushes this to high.
conditions: IF the course agent loads secrets or papers into prompts that are then sent to Perplexity
IF both agents are pointed at the same workspace containing configuration secrets
mitigations: Keep secrets out of any Perplexity-visible workspace
Move sensitive files to a separate directory with no upload path
Redact configuration secrets before analysis
requires-engineering: enforce per-directory access controls
requires-engineering: add DLP checks before outbound requests

C_capability_conflict.rationale: Perplexity has no host write access, but the course agent can execute shell commands, spawn subprocesses, and write files in a local development environment. If both operate on the same project tree, the course agent can overwrite artifacts that Perplexity’s outputs depend on, creating mutable-state conflicts. Because shared workspace isolation is not stated, uncertainty again favors the higher severity.
conditions: IF both agents target the same directory or notebook workspace
IF the course agent writes files that Perplexity later reads or summarizes
mitigations: Separate the agents into different working directories
Use read-only mounts for Perplexity-facing inputs
Pause one agent while the other writes to shared artifacts
requires-engineering: add file-locking around shared outputs

D_cascading_error.rationale: Perplexity produces cited answers from live search, and the course agent exposes agentic ask/stream endpoints that can turn prior outputs into new actions. If the course agent treats Perplexity’s text as authoritative without verification, errors can cascade into generated papers or notebook outputs. The pathway exists, but no direct automation between them is documented.
conditions: IF the course agent consumes Perplexity answers as ground truth without checking sources
IF downstream notebook or API steps reuse those answers in generated content
mitigations: Require source verification before reuse
Compare Perplexity claims against primary papers
Add a checklist step for citations and factual claims
requires-engineering: insert an automated fact-check stage

E_compliance.rationale: Perplexity’s privacy policy and vendor-hosted processing imply external handling of uploaded documents and browsing context, while the course agent explicitly handles configuration secrets and research materials in a local environment. If regulated or sensitive data is routed from the course agent into Perplexity, retention and residency expectations may diverge. The pairwise compliance mismatch is plausible but not directly evidenced.
conditions: IF regulated data from the course agent is sent to Perplexity
IF the operator expects local-only handling for secrets or papers
mitigations: Keep regulated data out of vendor-hosted queries
Review the privacy policy before uploading documents
Separate secret-bearing workflows from research workflows
requires-engineering: document retention and residency boundaries
requires-engineering: add a compliance gate before uploads
